Plugin.Name: Spacelens
Plugin.Overview: Shows what is using the space on a disk, pool or share, TreeSize style, with drill-down. Scans run in the background at low priority and give a treemap, a folder table, the largest files, growth since earlier scans, and optional scheduled scans with notifications when a target grows. User shares are scanned on each disk and pool directly and merged, so every folder shows how much of it is on each disk.
